HTTPBearer.description: An API token (starts with sc_) from Admin > API tokens.

info.description:
Read the company scorecard, write weekly numbers into it, and manage who owns
what.

**Authentication.** Send an API token as `Authorization: Bearer sc_...`.
Tokens are created on Admin > API tokens and shown once. Scopes: `read`
(GET only), `write` and `read_write` (GET and writes), `admin` (everything,
including people, sections, metric definitions, targets and archiving).
Admin accounts themselves are managed in the app, never through the API.

**Weeks.** A week is identified by its Monday, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in the business
timezone. Writes default to the last closed week, the one that is due. Future
weeks and weeks before a metric started are refused.

**Writes replace.** Writing a week sets its value, replacing any previous
value, including one typed by hand. Re-sending is safe. Every write is
recorded in the audit trail against the token.

Full reference with examples: `docs/API.md` in the repository.
info.title: Scorecard API

get.description: The seven CEO tiles, the metric filling each, and the categories of tiles that are broken down. Use it to find the names a breakdown call accepts. Any token scope.

post.description: Writes one week of a tile's categories in a single call, and optionally its total. All-or-nothing: every category name is checked first, and an unknown name writes nothing and returns the valid names. Names are never created. `slot` is revenue, expenses or leads. Needs a write, read_write or admin token.

parameters.description: The tile: revenue, expenses or leads
parameters.name: slot

schema.title: Slot

get.description: Ids and names to write to. Includes metrics in hidden sections. Any token scope.

schema.title: Response 200 List Metrics Api V1 Metrics Get

post.description: Adds a metric (or a client, in a roster section) at the bottom of its section. A second live metric with the same name in the section is refused. Set its target with PUT /metrics/{metric_id}/targets. Needs an admin token.

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent: rename, move section, reassign or clear the owner, and so on. The type cannot change, since the numbers already written would stop meaning anything; archive it and add a new one. Works on archived metrics too. Needs an admin token.

post.description: Takes a metric (for example a churned client) off every surface while keeping its history. Calling it again moves the effective week. Needs an admin token.
Sets the metric's value for one week, replacing any value already there (including one typed by hand). Idempotent: sending the same week again overwrites it. Needs a write, read_write or admin token.

put.description: Sets a numeric metric's baseline (weeks 1-6) and stretch (weeks 7-13) for one quarter. Both are required: half a target would score half the quarter against nothing. Idempotent. Needs an admin token.

post.description: Puts an archived metric back. Needs an admin token.

get.description: Every visible metric with its target, last closed and current week, trend and red streak, plus ready-made pending, stale and red lists. Scored by the same engine as the board and the TV. Any token scope.
Every section, hidden ones included, with the ids that `section_id` takes. Needs an admin token.

schema.title: Response 200 List Sections Api V1 Sections Get

post.description: Adds a section at the bottom of the board. A second section with the same name is refused, so re-running a setup script is safe. Needs an admin token.

get.description: Everyone with a login, active or not, with the ids that `dri_user_id` takes and how many live metrics each owns. Needs an admin token.

schema.title: Response 200 List Users Api V1 Users Get

post.description: Creates an editor or viewer login and returns a temporary password, once; they must change it at first sign-in. Admins are made in the app. Needs an admin token.

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent. is_active false signs them out everywhere and stops their nudges; the metrics they own keep them as owner until reassigned. Admin accounts cannot be changed here. Needs an admin token.
